map.根据旅行天数、出行类型（商务/休闲/户外）、性别与交通方式，推荐随身与托运行李的: From trip length, travel type (business / leisure / outdoor), gender and transport mode, recommend total carry-on and checked baggage weight ranges, with reference checked baggage limits of common airlines, to judge before departure whether bags may be overweight.
map.出行前按天数、类型（商务/休闲/户外）、性别、交通方式，预估随身+托运总重量区间: Before a trip, estimate the total carry-on plus checked weight range from days, type (business / leisure / outdoor), gender and transport mode, and compare against airline limits to see whether overweight fees apply.
map.户外/滑雪等装备重，提前算好托运区间，避免现场被迫拆分或付超额费。: Outdoor or ski gear is heavy, so compute the checked weight range in advance to avoid being forced to split bags or pay overweight fees on site.
map.多段交通（飞机+火车+自驾）时，以最严的托运限额为上限反推可带量。: For multi-leg trips (plane + train + car), use the strictest checked baggage limit as the ceiling to back out what you can bring.
map.算例（女性 5 天休闲国内飞机）: Worked example (female, 5 days, leisure, domestic flight)
map.：休闲 5 天基准：托运 15-23kg、随身 7-10kg；性别微调女 -2k: : leisure 5-day baseline: checked 15-23 kg, carry-on 7-10 kg; gender adjustment female −2 kg -> checked 13-21 kg, carry-on 5-8 kg. Free checked allowance in economy is usually 20-23 kg (domestic and international differ), so keep checked bags at or below 23 kg to avoid fees; carry-on 5-8 kg fits cabin bag weight limits (most carriers 5-10 kg). The outdoor baseline is higher (checked 20-30 kg), and above 23 kg you need to buy extra allowance in advance or split bags.
map.以承运航司客票标注的免费额度（经济舱常见 20-23kg/件、廉价航 0-15k: Based on the free allowance printed on the carrier's ticket (economy commonly 20-23 kg per piece, low-cost carriers 0-15 kg); this tool gives an empirical range, and your flight's allowance governs. Excess is charged at the carrier's rate, and buying allowance in advance is cheaper than at the airport.
map.随身和托运怎么分？: How to split carry-on and checked?
map.贵重/急用/液体超规走托运，证件/充电宝/常用药/换洗衣随身；登机箱限重+尺寸双: Valuables, urgent items and liquids over limits go in checked bags; documents, power banks, regular medication and a change of clothes go in carry-on; cabin bags are limited by both weight and size, so oversized bags may be checked even if not heavy.
